method: Fisher exact, one-tailed, corrected TWICE over all 174 runs as one family at alpha=0.05: Holm (family-wise error rate) certifies the number the ratchet freezes, Benjamini-Hochberg (false discovery rate) feeds the diagnosis, and the gap between the two sets is published. Classes are DERIVED from the null floor and the stored passes; no case declares its own power. The minimum viable arm for this family is n=8 — below it no observation the experiment can make would be certified, and its 'no effect' would be a property of the design, not of the world.

detection_power.effect_unit: percentage points of pass rate (with the strong model at ceiling)
